name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Suffix components are all semantic domain IDs, not address residue: '19' is the per-event handler dispatch index 0x19 (xref confirms entry at table base 0x51B91 + 0x19*4 = 0x51BF5); 'ch7' is chapter 7; 'first_time' is the event category (matches the sibling handlers' category suffixes, e.g. 0x1A is _char_cond). Body matches name: it is the ch7 turn-event handler dispatched at idx 0x19. No hex equal to its own/any data address. Name is consistent with the whole chapter_event_handler family.
purpose: Chapter 7 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x19): a first-time-gated second-stage beat that, only after tile-event slot 0x10 was consumed, reloads portrait set 2, pans the camera, plays cutscene 0x1E, shows dialog page 2, then consumes its own slot 0x11 (runs at most once).
logic_summary: Gate: if tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] == 1 (a prior event -- handler 0x1A -- already consumed slot 0x10). When the gate passes: set data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag=1, call fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2) (portrait set 2), set data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag=0 (bracketing the reload as an init-phase load), fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0x10,10), fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x1E), fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000,0x140,0xCD,0x4C,0x4A,0x13,1), then write tile_event_consumed_flags[0x11]=1 to consume its own slot. Single branch (the slot-0x10 gate); no RNG, no numeric computation, no use of any CALL return value. __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform dispatch argument passed by the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (all slots are 1-arg cdecl). This turn-event handler never reads it (cast to void in src). Distinct from tile-step handlers (e.g. 0x1A) which read the same slot as the stepping char id.
params.reason: Descriptive of its role as the unread uniform dispatch arg; not a param_1 placeholder and carries no address residue. Body genuinely ignores it, so the generic 'event_arg' is the correct name (a more specific name would mis-imply it is consumed).

returns.semantics: No return value; performs side effects only when the slot-0x10 gate passes.

reads_globals: data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (base of 0x20-byte tile-event consumed-flags block; gate reads byte [0x10])
writes_globals: data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag (set to 1 then 0 to bracket the portrait reload as an init-phase load)
comment_original_issue: Comment block content was accurate and well-scoped, but contained four em-dash characters ('—') in the prose (lines 1047, 1053, 1056, 1059), violating the ASCII-only rule for code comments.
notes: Two-stage relationship confirmed by decompiling sibling handler 0x1A @ 0x3499B: handler 0x1A consumes slot 0x10 when a non-enemy steps on the trigger tile, and only then does this handler 0x19 fire and consume slot 0x11. Ghidra plate already matches the refined src understanding (both describe the slot-0x10 gate, portrait set 2 bracketed by init_phase_flag, pan, cutscene 0x1E, dialog page 2, consume slot 0x11), so plate left untouched. comment_verdict=rewrite reflects only the em-dash->'--' ASCII fix; no semantic change to the comment. No logic/type/signature changes made.
